current.title: Currently working
current.body: As a Senior Backend Developer at Zigi App (Banco Industrial), I build the financial microservices behind a 100% digital Guatemalan application: event-driven architectures, security on AWS, and code built to scale.

about.title: Alexander here
about.subtitle: M.Sc. in Information Security (Cum Laude) · Systems Engineer · AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
about.p1: My name is Oscar Alexander, originally from Guatemala, with over 6 years of experience in software development. I am currently a Senior Backend Developer at Zigi App (Banco Industrial), building financial microservices with NestJS under Hexagonal Architecture, DDD and CQRS on AWS.
about.p2: I started programming at university. This, combined with a background in graphic design, gave me a broader view of how design and programming can be combined to create innovative and functional digital products.
about.p3: Feel free to reach out if you have an idea or project in mind, or to join a project where I can contribute my knowledge and skills.

contact.title: Shall we build something together?
contact.sub: Write to me and let's talk about your project, your team, or the architecture you have in mind.
